info.title: Lutetia API v1
info.description: Read-only data contract (ADR-5). v1 only adds, never changes. New resources use the envelopes {items, as_of, next} (+ source for snapshots) and {data, as_of}; the original four (devices, positions, telemetry, status) keep their own shapes. Timestamps are UTC with a trailing Z. Clients must ignore unknown fields; v1 only adds fields, never removes or renames. Clients must also accept enum values they do not know (for example a new manhole status) and treat them as unknown; v1 may add enum values.

bearerKey.description: Authorization: Bearer <key>. A key is checked alone; an invalid one is 401 with no fall-back to the session.

sessionCookie.name: lutetia_session
sessionCookie.description: Dashboard login (admin / orange / huawei). Used only when no Authorization header is sent. admin holds every scope; orange and huawei hold iot:read and poi:read.

Unauthorized.description: No credentials, or an invalid key.

Forbidden.description: Valid credentials without the scope in `x-scope`.

Timestamp.description: UTC instant, ISO 8601 with a trailing Z.

Error.description: Every error response has exactly this shape.

Cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor: pass the previous response's `next` unchanged.

NextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

Collector.description: Heartbeat of the collector. With no heartbeat row at all everything is null except stale = true.

Receiver.description: Push receiver counters. null when the collector has never written a heartbeat.

ManholeStatus.description: Priority order, first match wins. inactive = not expected online (or unknown); offline stays offline even with an unfinished event (open_event reports that).

planned_tonnes.description: null when no segment has a weight: weight pending, never 0.

manholes.description: total = in-use manholes (not inactive) = moved_24h + offline + quiet (moving is part of moved_24h); all = total + inactive.

pois.description: null when the caller does not hold poi:read.

account.description: Account name of the session, or the caller name of the key.

hourly.description: true for days=30: each point is the average of one hour, stamped at the start of the hour.

truncated.description: true when a series had more than 1500 points and only the newest 1500 are returned.

sla_text.description: SLA duration as written in the template; null when the template gives none.

sla_value.description: sla_text parsed at import: the number (the upper bound of a range such as 1-2 days); null when sla_text is null or could not be parsed.

sla_value_min.description: Lower bound when sla_text is a range; null for a single value or when not parsed.

sla_unit.description: Unit of sla_value: today minute, hour, day, workday, week, month or tonne_per_day (a dismantling rate, not a duration). Null exactly when sla_value is null. May gain new values; clients must tolerate unknown values.

sla_scope.description: Network layer the value applies to, from a prefix in the template: today access, aggregation, backbone, or other (a prefix not recognised: see the source table). Null without a prefix or when sla_value is null. May gain new values; clients must tolerate unknown values.
